description:
[read-only] Playlists of the YouTube channel(s) a brand publishes to. Use a playlist id as `youtube.playlistId` on create_content or publish.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/youtube/playlists.)

brandId.description: An id from GET /api/v2/brands, or "personal". Omitted → the key's bound brand, else the owner's personal accounts.

name: list_youtube_playlists
title: List YouTube playlists
